summary: Full backend + frontend regression of the new K-HTT Analyst module (Elastech Production). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_kht.py covering dashboard, list+search, get/404, PUT rating status toggle + clamp + summary/recommendation edit, trend, color-scale (11 levels 0..10), single & chunked uploads + file serving, analyze/start missing-image 404, full AI analyze flow (Gemini vision returned rating/status/params/summary/recommendation in ~25s), soft-delete. Frontend: /khtt dashboard shows all 4 stat tiles (Total 4 / Clear 2 / Tarnish 2 / Avg 7.1) and full sidebar sub-nav; History tab loads 4 seeded records, filter chips work (Clear -> 2 cards), search wired to backend q param, selection mode + select-all + selected-count + combined PDF export toast fires ('Menyiapkan PDF gabungan (4 sample).') and printHtmlOnWeb appends the pdf-print-frame iframe; Trend renders SVG polyline with 4 trend-point-* links; Color Scale page shows color-scale-image data-URI + 11 color-level rows; New Test defaults are correct (KHT-YYYY-MM-DD-nnn auto id, oil default 'Engine Oil SAE 15W-40', temp 320, duration 16, air 10, oil 0.31); gallery-input + CropEditor + 4 handles + crop-use-full produce image-preview; run-analysis without image shows correct toast. Result page rating edit -> 5 toggles status to TARNISH visibly; rating 11 validation shows toast 'Angka color scale harus 0 - 10.'; summary + recommendation edits persist across page reload; view-mode-heatmap/original toggle works; kht-back-btn returns; unknown id shows result-not-found + result-go-home. Regression landing / /copper-strip /rating-dka render with navy/cyan theme and no page errors.

issues: Tanggal Uji uses the browser default HTML date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a shadcn Calendar component - flagged only per design guideline; not part of K-HTT scope.

action_items: Result-page edits in this test run mutated the seeded record KHT-2026-05-30-001 (rating changed to 5 -> TARNISH, ai_summary='TEST_SUMMARY_XYZ123', recommendation='TEST_REC_ABC789'). If a pristine demo dataset is desired, main agent should restore original seed values (rating 8.7 / performance 'VERY GOOD' / original Indonesian summary & recommendation) or re-run the seeding logic after clearing db.tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: analyze/start uses asyncio.create_task inside a request handler which is fine but has no concurrency limit or per-user throttle; consider a small semaphore around run_ai_vision to prevent EMERGENT_LLM_KEY quota bursts.
server.py _chunk_buffers is an in-process dict - chunk uploads won't survive worker restarts or scale horizontally; acceptable for MVP but worth documenting.
server.py delete_test returns 404 only if matched_count==0 but does not distinguish already-deleted records (idempotent delete); minor.

pdf.js printHtmlOnWeb removes the iframe after 1.4s which is fine for real browsers but makes it slightly harder to verify in headless tests; consider firing a custom event 'kht:pdf-ready' before print() for testability.
seed_data_creation: None. AI-analyzed test record created during test_analyze_full_flow was soft-deleted at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed data (4 KHT-2026-05-* records) is created on backend startup only if db.tests is empty. In this run I edited the newest seed (KHT-2026-05-30-001) to verify edit persistence; main agent may want to reset. All backend endpoints in /api/kht/* work; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and printHtmlOnWeb appends an iframe with data-testid=pdf-print-frame (removed ~1.4s later).
